findings.entity: handheld grooming tool in the real man's hand (vs. its mirror reflection)
findings.description: At 00:02.00 the real man holds a pale/silver straight-razor-like blade. From 00:02.25 to 00:04.00 the object in his real hand becomes a dark comb-like tool pushed into his hair at the temple, while the mirror reflection simultaneously shows a pale white blade at his forehead/eyebrow. At 00:04.25 the real-hand object is a pale blade again. No swap, put-down, or pickup is visible; the tool changes kind and disagrees with its own reflection.
